response: Intrapartum vibroacoustic stimulation (VAS) is an effective predictor of fetal acidosis, but its effectiveness varies depending on the type of fetal heart rate (FHR) decelerations. Specifically, VAS is a good predictor of fetal acidosis in cases of FHR variable decelerations. However, its predictability for fetal acidosis in cases of FHR late decelerations is limited. Additionally, both VAS and fetal blood pH are useful predictors of neonatal morbidity.
